newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan government, opposition MPs exchange blows.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan government, opposition MPs exchange blows.

text.p: Kenyan members of parliament exchanged blows inside the chamber on Thursday as the opposition disrupted a budget speech to highlight demands for constitutional reforms, reporters said.
A Reuters correspondent, watching from the press gallery, said the fight between opposition and ruling party MPs lasted several minutes and was in full view of President Daniel arap Moi.
Finance Minister Musalia Mudavadi doggedly read his speech but it was inaudible above the din created by shouting, stamping opposition members.
There was chaos and the fighting lasted several minutes. Finance Minister Musalia Mudavadi then proceeded to read the speech but he was inaudible as the opposition shouted throughout.
Opposition member of parliament Paul Muite described the situation as totally chaotic.
"There is pandemonium inside parliament. There was an exchange of blows between parliamentarians. It is total chaos," said Muite who was earlier expelled from the chamber for disorderly behaviour.
